_doc: Compiler profiles. A project selects one via "compiler" in its config.json or --profile. Paths are relative to the project dir unless absolute; ${VAR} env vars expand. Nothing here is vendored: see docs/compilers.md for how to obtain each.

old_agbcc.source: pret/agbcc; used for stock m4a/Sappy sound engine code

gcc-2.96-patched.notes: Flag set mirrors Coaltergeist/goldensun-decomp Makefile (checked 2026-10-07). Driver emits asm via -S, then arm-none-eabi-as.

arm-none-eabi-gcc.source: system ARM GNU toolchain (scripts/install_toolchain.sh); modern, for homebrew/tests only

ads12.source: ARM Developer Suite 1.2 (armcc/tcc/armcpp, 2001-02): proprietary, FLEXlm-licensed, discontinued; no free legal download, so this toolkit never runs it
ads12.notes: For ADS-built games (e.g. Webfoot's Dragon Ball Z GBA titles). No byte matching: init makes an asm-only project (byte-identical split for labelling/documenting) or a notes-only project (function table, no build). See docs/compilers.md.
